method: Sequential fresh wiki creations through Special:CreateWiki; login and form preparation excluded. Provisioning completion observed every 500 ms.
timing_clock: Host monotonic duration; queue/start times use Redis stream/status timestamps, with legacy Docker volume file timestamps as fallback.

source_sync.method: Compose Watch sync+exec to local staging; fair gate and dispatch lock protect publication; persistent PHP consumer reloads at dispatch boundaries. Host source is mounted read-only at /sync-input solely for startup/reconciliation. CLI OPcache remains disabled.
source_sync.provisioner_source_paths: Container writable layer, not host bind mounts
source_sync.initialization: First full copy took several minutes for 87,722 files. Subsequent changes publish incrementally; publication still scans the source trees.
source_sync.previous_measurements: Previous bind-mounted runs varied substantially (4.83–17.72s uninstrumented; 3.43–11.93s instrumented). These are sequential observations, not a controlled randomized comparison.
